text: External verifier backends for the harness: recompute-kit, ThoughtProof
description: From the 2026-11-08 research + Boardy intros: Tiago Merlini's recompute-kit independently re-checks agent actions and returns verified/failed/unverifiable (call Tue 17 Nov); Raul Jaeger's ThoughtProof blocks a proposal with a structured objection until repaired (call Fri 13 Nov). Both match the verifier stage interface. First step is conversational: ask both what evidence their verifier needs and whether an aimparency idea + diff + commands is enough input. Only then build an adapter.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude. Talk to Raul (13 Nov) and Tiago (17 Nov) before building anything.
